videos.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings: World Tour
videos.description: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console, and Grizzy is transported into the game.

videos.title: Duck and Frog
videos.description: Duck and Frog are working at a supermarket alongside Toad and Flamingo, who keep ruining Duck and Frog's hard work to make them look bad. Why are they being so mean.

videos.title: Pokémon Horizons
videos.description: Don't Give Up, Crocalor! Roy, Crocalor and Kilowattrel take on Drayton in a spirited rematch.

videos.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
videos.description: Vexius attacks the Winx at Magixia's fair, pushing the fairies to rise together.

videos.title: The Next Step: Cheer
videos.description: Levi tries to keep the team calm for Social Media Day after Denise announces big changes. Jordan practises her cheer smile, and Melody works on an improved full-out.

videos.title: Newsround
videos.description: 21/11/2026. Topical news magazine for children.

videos.title: Blue Peter: Meet Our New Presenter!
videos.description: Meet Our New Presenter! Meet new BP presenter Leo, who takes to the skies in an incredible skydive challenge.

videos.title: Deadly 60
videos.description: Steve Backshall heads to Oman, where he abseils to a verreaux's eagle nest, tracks down wolves and swims alongside a super pod made up of over 100 dolphins.

videos.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
videos.description: At Longmeadow, Monty has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment.

videos.title: Naturewatch
videos.description: The team dives into some intriguing autumn mysteries: why don't seals drown? What is the UK's most deadly mushroom? And what extraordinary creature has the power to keep autumn leaves alive.

videos.title: My Life at Christmas: Anita Rani Meets Floella Benjamin
videos.description: Anita Rani pays a Christmas visit to Baroness Floella Benjamin to reflect on a remarkable life shaped by family, faith and the festive season.

videos.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
videos.description: Marcus finds that getting his own ducks proves more of an adventure than he anticipated.

videos.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
videos.description: Easy celebration bakes, from a meringue layer cake to a seafood extravaganza.

videos.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
videos.description: Adaptation of Oscar Wilde's masterpiece, set in 1890s England. A comedy of mistaken identity ensues when two gentlemen friends use the same alias to pursue the women they love.

videos.title: Strangers on a Train
videos.description: Alfred Hitchcock's suspense classic in which two men who meet by accident plot a perfect murder. From the novel by Patricia Highsmith.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: The programme comes from the Platform in Morecambe, Lancashire. Paul Martin discovers the rags-to-riches story of the town's most famous son - Eric Morecambe.

videos.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
videos.description: Bob Harris and Suzi Perry swap music and motors for a Japanese boat and Westwood jewels.

videos.title: The Eagle Has Landed
videos.description: All-action World War II adventure. A squad of German paratroopers is sent to England to kidnap Winston Churchill. Based on the bestseller by Jack Higgins.

videos.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 3
videos.description: A collection of 40 rarely seen musical moments that don't often get to escape from the BBC vaults. Including Roachford, David Bowie, Mary J Blige and Gloria Estefan.

videos.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 2
videos.description: Another deep dive into the BBC's music archives to uncover 40 rarely seen performances.

videos.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC
videos.description: Expect the unexpected on this journey through the BBC's magical music archives, a Top 40 with a difference.

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: The third leg of the race sees the teams leave behind the jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail.

videos.title: Bill's Included
videos.description: When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students.

videos.title: This is BBC Two
videos.description: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

videos.title: Countryfile
videos.description: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the fastest animal in the world - the peregrine falcon.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

videos.title: Landward
videos.description: In a special episode from north Sutherland, Dougie steps out into the Flow Country. Arlene catches up with Joyce Campbell, who has made the switch from sheep to regenerative farming.

videos.title: Beechgrove Repotted
videos.description: Beechgrove joins Dina Watt as she creates delicious dishes with an Indonesian twist, cooked with her own homegrown veg.

videos.title: A Cook Abroad: Tony Singh's India
videos.description: Cooking show. Scottish chef Tony Singh travels to India to trace his family roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is the real deal.

videos.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
videos.description: How one of the greatest French arts is that of patisserie.

videos.title: The Man Who Never Was
videos.description: Espionage thriller based on the true story of an intelligence officer who plans an elaborate hoax to fool the Nazis into thinking the Allies are about to invade Greece, not Sicily.

videos.title: Homes Under the Hammer
videos.description: In Scotland, Martel encounters a house with a safety order attached to it, which means certain rooms can't be accessed.

videos.title: MOTD Live: Women's Super League
videos.description: Coverage of the Women's Super League clash between Arsenal and West Ham United.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: This episode of the antiques series comes from Longleat in Wiltshire, home to a safari park and Longleat House. Paul Martin is joined by Michael Baggott and Claire Rawle.

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it's a land of extreme contrasts.

videos.title: This Farming Life
videos.description: Carianne searches for the missing mother of a newborn calf. Rachel and Camy are on the hills tending to their Cheviots. John and Heather help to deliver their Beltex lambs.

videos.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
videos.description: Eva explores the history of French cuisine through a seven-course fine dining meal aboard a Seine riverboat with chef Eric Ripert and writer Lindsey Tramuta.

videos.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
videos.description: Simon Reeve travels around Ireland. Starting at the spectacular Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, Simon travels down the east coast, ending in the Wicklow Mountains.

videos.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
videos.description: Paul and Bob fish two vast loughs in County Tyrone, hoping to lure an elusive pike out of hiding. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will he manage to catch one.

videos.title: A Course Called Ireland
videos.description: With brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, Bill reflects on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf helped bind nine siblings together. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Rewarding
videos.description: Beacon Fold's training day goes awry as Nicola gets her own taste of care work. Contains adult humour.

videos.title: Sunday Politics
videos.description: Mark Carruthers looks at the political developments of the week and questions policymakers on the key issues.

videos.title: Uncanny: The Cliffsend Haunting
videos.description: Lindsey and her family experience terrifying events in their new-build house on the Isle of Thanet in Kent. Could the answers lie beneath their feet.

videos.title: Live at the Apollo
videos.description: Tim Renkow welcomes comedians Janine Harouni and Stuart Goldsmith to the stage. Contains some strong language and adult humour.

videos.title: Suzie Lee's Great Food Made Simple
videos.description: Suzie visits Tully Mill in Co Fermanagh and is inspired to make a chocolate brownie with a chocolate mousse and a cherry compote.

videos.title: Blue Velvet
videos.description: A young student finds himself stuck in a dark underworld of crime and depravity. Contains strong language, some sexual content, sexual violence and some..

videos.title: Question Time
videos.description: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Worthing. On the panel are David Lammy, Joe Robertson, Adrian Ramsay, Alex Depledge and Fraser Nelson.

videos.title: Honey
videos.description: Martha and Kurt must gain access to Kamilla and locate Greta before Friedrich does. Contains some strong language, some sexual content and some upsetting..

videos.title: This is BBC Two
videos.description: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

videos.title: Bargain Hunt
videos.description: Eric Knowles visits Nottingham's Gothic revival cathedral to learn how conservators are revealing 19th-century artwork under decades of plaster and paint.

videos.title: Blue Planet III
videos.description: A look at the surprising connections between the world's oceans, from the icy worlds of the poles to unexpected coasts closer to home.

videos.title: Match of the Day
videos.description: Highlights of Sunday's two Premier League games as Liverpool take on Manchester United at Anfield and high-flying Brighton go to Hull City. Kelly Cates presents.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

videos.title: Politics Live
videos.description: The big political issues of the day.

videos.title: Impossible
videos.description: Game show in which players score points by answering questions correctly while avoiding the Impossible answers.

videos.title: Bridge of Lies
videos.description: A team of family and friends, Amy, JP, Nic and Alan, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they must cross the Bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies.

videos.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
videos.description: Colin Murray visits the Walled City Market and discovers a brown sauce revival.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael starts a new railway journey in Newcastle, heading north to Berwick-upon-Tweed.

videos.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
videos.description: As Storm Arwen hits UK waters, Revival goes in search of North Sea prawns.

videos.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
videos.description: Michael Aspel and the team head for Coughton Court in Warwickshire, where the experts get excited about an Agatha Christie letter and a rare china figure of the Queen on horseback.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: Paul Martin is joined by experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon in Oxford Union to pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at auction.

videos.title: House of Games
videos.description: Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

videos.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
videos.description: Ellie Taylor begins the week by having an exclusive chat with the latest couple to bow out.

videos.title: Global Eye
videos.description: Nomsa Maseko reports from South Africa, where a series of shocking murders has exposed the dangers that women face. Contains scenes which some viewers may find upsetting.

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.description: Clive Myrie hosts and contenders answer questions on specialist subjects including Marilyn Monroe, Katherine Mansfield and The Sopranos.

videos.title: Only Connect
videos.description: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far. It's another rematch, where the teams know each other from before but can't afford to drop their guard.

videos.title: University Challenge
videos.description: In another second-round match, the team from Bristol take on their neighbours on the Avon at the University of Bath for a place in the quarter-finals. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Lucy has the keys to the Doge's Palace in Venice, where she has a close shave in a torture chamber and discovers a 24-carat gold staircase, hidden doors and secret messages.

videos.title: Ceolta
videos.description: Fiachna Ó Braonáin and Eve Belle introduce performances from Winnie Ama, And So I Watch You from Afar and Hothouse Flowers.

videos.title: Newsnight
videos.description: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Katie Razzall.

videos.title: Blood
videos.description: Two brothers investigate a despicable crime in a small town, in the shadow of their former police chief father. Contains strong language and some violent scenes.
